name: AI Content Creator
description: Adds an AJAX 'Generate content' panel to node forms that drafts text from a prompt via the OpenAI API.
project_description: AI Content Creator adds an 'AI Content Generator' details panel to the add/edit form of selected node types. An author types a free-text prompt and clicks 'Generate content'; an AJAX callback calls the OpenAI Chat/Completions API through a Guzzle-based service and returns the generated text in a modal dialog with a 'Copy to clipboard' button. The generated text is not written into any field automatically — the author copies it into the fields they want. A single admin settings form stores the OpenAI endpoint URL, access token, model, max-tokens and temperature, and the content types that show the panel. The module talks to OpenAI directly (it does not use the drupal/ai abstraction) and ships no permissions or config schema of its own.
